widgets_values: Create a grid of 4 images, each image is 16:9 aspect ratio. Create an entire ad campaign for this cream.  The model is holding and showcasing the cream.  A closeup focused shot just on the product. Extreme closeup focused on the cream being applied. A top down shot showing the cream, the lid is open and the lid is placed next to the cream container on the left. Written on the lid in the same holographic style as REID is a small tagline that says "Your Skin Will Thank You". Professional studio lighting, against a black background.
